findings.title: Firmware rule 8: the hold-up "after the PA6 trip" (0.157-0.182 ms / 0.44-0.48 ms) is computed from 5.3 V, above the stated trip window (VLOGIC 4.84-5.17 V); from the window it is 0.103-0.164 ms / 0.291-0.430 ms
findings.contradicts: The same rule's trip window: "the PA6 trip window is VLOGIC about 4.8-5.2 V (PA6 0.44-0.47 V) ... PA6's lower edge 0.44 V x 11 = 4.84 V" (r10_binding_note.json firmware_obligations[43]; docs/M3_R10.md Firmware rule 8, lines 1014-1018; REQUIREMENTS F6 line 60; R10_VALIDATION row 25 line 2164). Hold-up after the trip must start at VLOGIC at the trip, i.e. 0.44-0.47 V x 11 = 4.84-5.17 V (R60 100k / R61 10k on the board), not 5.3 V. M3_R10 line 616 even says "from the trip at about 5.3 V".
findings.evidence: Board: VLOGIC_SENSE = R60.2 (100k, F(32.77,58.6)) / R61.1 (10k, F(32.77,54.0)) / C60 / U1.30 (PA6), ratio 11. Calculation (.supervisor/r25_mcu/holdup.py on parts_budget.json battery_break_load_W, constant power, C84 counted as 300.8 uF, to the AP63203 3.8 V floor): it reproduces the record's figures exactly from the record's inputs (7.4 V: 0.464-0.539 ms all ports, 1.304-1.412 ms camera off; 5.3 V: 0.157-0.182 / 0.441-0.478 ms). From the stated window: trip at 5.17 V (PA6 0.47 V) 0.141-0.164 ms all ports / 0.397-0.430 ms camera off; trip at 4.84 V (PA6 0.44 V) 0.103-0.120 ms / 0.291-0.315 ms. The stated lower bound 0.157 ms overstates the window's worst case 0.103 ms by 52 % (camera off 0.44 vs 0.29 ms, 51 %). Even the 1 % divider spread puts the PA6 = 0.47 V point at VLOGIC <= 0.47 x 11.20 = 5.26 V, still below 5.3 V.
findings.impact: The owner's open hold-up question (R10_VALIDATION row 25, R19-REQ-07) and the shedding budget are decided on figures up to about 1.5x too long; firmware shedding latency would be sized against 0.157 ms when a trip at the window's lower edge leaves 0.103 ms with all ports on.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only. Quote the hold-up from the trip window: "Hold-up after the trip is 0.10-0.16 ms with all ports on and 0.29-0.43 ms with the camera off / shed (Calculation, from VLOGIC 4.84-5.17 V at 300.8 uF)" in m3_design/r10_sch_check.py rule 8 (regenerate r10_binding_note.json), docs/M3_R10.md lines 616 ("from the trip at about 5.3 V") and 1017-1018, docs/REQUIREMENTS.md F6, docs/ORDERING.md line 674, docs/R10_VALIDATION.md rows 5 (line 2134, "about a third" -> about a fifth to a third) and 25 (line 2164); update the test that pins the rule 8 words.

observations: U1 pin map: all 100 pads on board 92c3ad59 equal pin_table.tsv r10_net, the binding note u1_pins (port, net and mode text) and schematic.net.xml; pad order is the DS12110 Rev 8 Figure 5 LQFP100 counter-clockwise sequence (pin 1 at F(17.0,50.55), footprint rotated so pins 1-25 run along the bottom edge).

Alternate functions spot-checked against DS12110 Rev 8 Tables 10-14: PB12/PB13 AF14 UART5_RX/TX, PB6 AF10 QUADSPI_BK1_NCS, PB2 AF9 QUADSPI_CLK, PE2/PD11/PD12/PD13 AF9 QSPI IO, PE7/PE8 AF7 UART7, PD8/PD9 AF7 USART3, PC6/PC7 AF7 USART6, PC10-12 AF6 SPI3; ADC channels PA6 ADC12_INP3, PC5 ADC12_INP8, PC0 ADC123_INP10; PC1 TRACED0 and RTC_TAMP3/WKUP5 (Table 9 p. 67).

Pin-table page citations (Table 9 pp. 64-87, Tables 10-14, 119, 120, 122, 126-128, 146, 147, 157, 159, 160, 189, 192, Figure 95) land on the cited Rev 8 pages; I/O structures (PE4 FT_h, PA4 TT_a, PA5 TT_ha, PA6 FT_a, PC5 TT_a, PB1 TT_u, PB12/13 FT_u, PD8/9 and PC6/7 FT_h) match.
Binding note hashes: board 92c3ad59, netlist 762bc13d, pin table b94133e6 and circuit aeb1674f all equal the committed files.

Port wiring: J410.3/.4 = PD8 TX / PD9 RX through R441/R440, J420 = PB13/PB12 through R451/R450, J440 = PC6/PC7 through R471/R470 (all 1k); camera J9.3 -> R100 -> U12.1 (B2 in) -> U12.4 (A2Y out) -> PE7 RX, PE8 -> U12.5 (A1 in), as TXU0202 Table 6-1 requires.

Copper behind other obligations: R123 2k / C123 at Q122, R127 1k at PE4 (0.116 V at a 30 kohm / 3.6 V pull-up), R431 100k on CAM_PWR_EN, R102 10k on CAM_UART_OE, R460-R464 10k to 3V3, R10/R11 10k on QSPI_NCS/IMU_CS, R12/R13 4.7k on I2C1, U5 PS = 3V3A and CSB = GND (0x77), R9/R110 1k/1k on PC8, R104/R105 = /11 on PB1, 10.2k/1k banks on PC0/PC5 (/11.2), R164 2.2 ohm 3V3 -> 3V3A with VREF+ = VDDA, VBAT = 3V3, U4 INT1 -> PE1.
IWDG arithmetic: (239 + 1) x 4 = 960 LSI cycles; 28.571-32.653 ms at 33.6-29.4 kHz (DS12110 Rev 8 Table 146 p. 238, TJ -40 to 125 C).

Rule 8's other figures reproduce: U9 off window 4.288-4.802 V (4.778 V without D402), on window 4.723-5.251 V, from SLVSFC9C p9 VUVLO(R) 1.183-1.223 V, VUVLO(F) 1.076-1.116 V, IENLKG +/-0.1 uA, 1 % resistors, D402 50 nA; obligation 17's 1.401 V and 10.3 ms at 6.0 V also reproduce.

DS12110 Rev 8 Table 120 allows no injected current (-0/0) on PA4 and PA5; both are open-drain status inputs pulled to 3V3 by R91 / R89 10k, so no injection path was found (U11 ST behaviour during reverse blocking stays the recorded Inference of rule 7).

The LOGIC_SOURCE_ST, ACT_GATE and BOOT0 parallel-via pairs sit 0.566 / 0.849 / 0.566 mm centre to centre (0.3 mm drills); hole-to-hole spacing against JLC limits is the manufacturing lens's item and was not judged here.
